name: Compact Expense Status & Collapse
notes: V15.2.24 compacts the desktop expense cards to the approved typography and spacing, places active due warnings beside Unpaid, removes standalone Deadline/Expense prefixes, uses 20x20 section collapse controls, and sets the footer to the existing 30x30 repeat artwork followed by 74x30 Mark paid and 48x30 Edit controls with 5px gaps. Phone and coarse-pointer tablet layouts, Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V3, recurrence, payments, calculations, balances, and sync behavior remain unchanged.
